purpose: Record the ordinal-only admissibility-boundary states and transition logic for mismatch transitions under a declared <S> and r_a without assigning numeric magnitudes.

AdmBoundary.definition: A declared admissibility condition separating lawful continuation from inadmissible continuation within a specified domain, scale, and coupling context.

BoundaryApproach.definition: A governed ordinal transition pattern indicating movement toward a declared admissibility boundary under repeated Delta evaluation.

BoundaryContact.definition: The first evaluated condition satisfying the declared admissibility-boundary contact rule.
BoundaryContact.note: Contact does not by itself imply admissibility break.

BoundaryCrossing.definition: A transition across a declared admissibility boundary.

BoundaryRetreat.definition: A governed transition pattern indicating movement away from a previously approached or contacted admissibility boundary.

BoundaryPersistence.definition: Repeated boundary contact or near-boundary classification without immediate admissibility break.

formal_reading.delta_role: Delta evaluates mismatch under a declared symmetry-reference coupling.
formal_reading.boundary_role: PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056 governs the admissibility-boundary behavior of those transitions.
formal_reading.separation_rule: Delta evaluation, ordinal classification, transition discipline, and boundary dynamics remain distinct governed layers.

forbidden_inference: BoundaryApproach does not imply numeric distance.
BoundaryContact does not imply scalar equality.
BoundaryCrossing does not imply spatial crossing.
BoundaryPersistence does not imply topological stability.
No ordinal boundary state licenses metric magnitude.
